About yourPDF

yourPDF is an independent PDF and image toolkit maintained by Sarvesh Singh. It helps with specific document-preparation tasks: combining certificates, selecting report pages, correcting orientation and preparing images to stated dimensions.

What makes this workflow useful

Selected documents are processed in the browser instead of being uploaded to a conversion server. You can try the PDF tools with built-in samples, review page order and download the result without creating an account. The practice-file collection gives you known inputs and concrete output checks.

What we do and do not check

Image checks measure format, pixels and bytes. They do not certify whether a university, employer or government portal will accept a file. PDF edits can affect forms, bookmarks and digital signatures. Structural optimization does not promise a smaller file or recompress scanned images. Read the supported limits before processing important documents.

Content and corrections

The guides explain the operations implemented on this site, with synthetic examples. Example dimensions are labelled as examples, not official requirements. If an explanation is wrong or an output differs from its example, send a correction or bug report. We update instructions when the corresponding behavior changes.

Maintenance

Changes to code and content are recorded in the public source repository. See recent changes for a readable summary. Automated checks cover core file operations; they do not establish compatibility with every browser or document.

Privacy and funding

The available tools are free to use. Advertising is currently disabled. Ordinary page requests still reach the hosting provider, Netlify. See Privacy for what local processing means and Contact for support.

Open-source foundations

PDF modifications use pdf-lib and rendering uses PDF.js. The interface, workflows and guides are maintained in this project. Library licenses and notices are available here. yourPDF is not affiliated with Google, Netlify or other PDF-tool brands.
